Coming up

    In your own calendar, Recurday shows what's coming up, and Add to calendar puts it on your phone with a reminder a week before and the day before.

    Their year

    Each one comes back every year. A family adds photos of the day, then rewatches the years as the kids grow.

    • Pajama Pancake Breakfast

      Third Saturday in January

      Nobody gets dressed. Whoever wakes up last flips the first pancake.

      Add to calendar

    • Kite Day

      Second Sunday in March

      First windy Sunday of spring. Everyone decorates a tail ribbon.
